events.title: Brute-force search over polynomial-size B2 compression blocks is exponential
formal_statement: With two fixed distinct root literals p,q, each fresh B2 gate can choose at least between e_i=(p AND q) and e_i=(p AND NOT q), both syntactically legal.
Therefore K-gate replacement blocks contain at least 2^K syntactic sequences.
For growing K, exhaustive block enumeration is not polynomial even though every individual replacement block has polynomial size.
Cheap proof verification does not repair candidate discovery cost.

events.title: Nonuniform projection-size frontier is exactly NP subseteq P/poly
formal_statement: If every polynomial-size verifier/circuit existential projection has polynomial-size circuits with one fixed polynomial bound, every NP language has polynomial-size circuits, hence NP subseteq P/poly.
Conversely, if NP subseteq P/poly, the universal NP language U={(C,y): exists w C(w,y)} has polynomial-size circuits; hardwiring C yields a polynomial-size circuit for y -> exists w C(w,y).
Therefore universal polynomial projection-size existence iff NP subseteq P/poly.
By Karp-Lipton, NP subseteq P/poly implies PH collapses to Sigma_2^p.
events.external_basis: Karp-Lipton theorem; standard P/poly circuit theory.
events.claim_ceiling: This is a nonuniform equivalence, not P=NP. A general superpolynomial projection-size lower bound would prove NP not subseteq P/poly and hence a major circuit lower bound.

events.title: Uniform semantic exact projection compiler is equivalent to P=NP
formal_statement: A uniform polynomial-time exact projection compiler decides SAT by projecting all SAT variables to a zero-input circuit, so it implies P=NP.

If P=NP, the universal predicate A(C,y)=exists x C(x,y) is in P; standard P-uniform circuitization with C hardwired constructs polynomial-size circuits for the projected function, then translates them to B2.
Thus the broad semantic uniform projection compiler is essentially equivalent to P=NP.
This does not establish an equivalence for the stronger requirement of polynomial Extended-Resolution proof certificates for every compiled projection.
events.external_basis: Standard theorem: P equals the class of languages decided by P-uniform polynomial-size circuit families.
events.claim_ceiling: Reformulating P=NP as an unrestricted uniform projection compiler is not by itself progress; progress requires an independently analyzable structural construction mechanism.

active_front.name: U1_L_CERTIFIED_LOCAL_TO_GLOBAL_PROJECTION_GRAMMAR
active_front.question: Can an independently specified structural grammar, rather than a black-box projection compiler, decompose every B2 projection into polynomially many locally certified rewrites while keeping total state polynomial and avoiding semantic recognition/backtracking?
active_front.reason_for_front: The unrestricted semantic compiler is equivalent to P=NP, so a useful next theorem must exploit additional structure instead of assuming the equivalent object.
